greeting: Sovereign on comms. Stage 4: Seven Crystals United. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Fallen Crown. Objective drift gets teams buried.
A map sneezed in my pocket and revealed a hidden staircase. True story.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Gather all seven Crystals.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Gather all seven Crystals; Perform the Unification Ritual; Awaken the Progenitor power. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Attune all seven Crystals and unlock their true power. Immediate move: Gather all seven Crystals.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: Seven Crystals United. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Void Zone Beckons.
rumor: Rumor says a sealed throne room is still issuing orders through static.
People keep repeating one clue from Seven Crystals United: 'Awaken the Progenitor power'.
The floor attempted a mutiny at dawn. We resolved it with better boots.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives the cleanest sightlines in the capital ruins. Move before crowds regroup.
dialog.time_noon: Noon is surveillance peak. Assume every lane is observed.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk favors ambush teams and rumor storms. Confirm every briefing twice.
dialog.time_night: Night in the crown district means quiet knives and loud mistakes. Stay disciplined.

party_reactions.kade: Sovereign sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Sovereign accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Sovereign talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
